propositions: Rebar hardcodes DC comment truncation at 32767 characters, ignoring the admin-configurable jira.text.field.character.limit property whose range is 0 (unlimited) to 2147483647, causing silent data loss when an administrator raises the limit

Comments longer than 32767 but acceptable under a raised jira.text.field.character.limit are truncated by rebar and permanently diverge from the remote, though a truncation warning is emitted to the operator
The DC comment ceiling must be made configurable via ReconcilerConfig.comment_max_chars, defaulting to 32767 per jira.text.field.character.limit's documented default and JRASERVER-28519

sanitize_comment previously reused the description fitter fit_outbound, creating a latent trap where future description fitter changes (especially Cloud's ADF-size-based fitting) could silently retarget comment truncation
Discovery of the live jira.text.field.character.limit via /rest/api/2/application-properties is not viable because the endpoint requires admin credentials and rebar authenticates as an ordinary user
